2609.09768.title: Fine-Tuning a KV Cache Concatenation-Aware Model or Recomputing KV Caches? Why Not Both?
2609.09768.paper_summary: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, a large number of retrieved chunks are concatenated to form the input context so that users can receive high-quality responses based on external knowledge. As a result, the input context length increases substantially, leading to a larger prefill workload and, in turn, a longer time to first token (TTFT). While previous works that reuse precomputed key-value (KV) caches effectively reduce TTFT for long-context inputs, it remains unclear whether response quality is preserved when the input context becomes very long. In this paper, we propose a combined approach that (i) fine-tunes the model while taking KV cache concatenation into account and (ii) selectively recomputes a subset of the KV caches. By applying both techniques, we demonstrate improved accuracy for long-context inputs. Experiments on the RULER benchmark show that, for a 124k-token input, our method improves the RULER score by 9.7 point over the baseline that recomputes KV caches only. Moreover, TTFT is reduced by 80% compared with full attention.
2609.09768.paper_summary_zh: 在檢索增強生成（RAG）系統中，大量檢索到的片段被串接起來形成輸入上下文，以便用戶能夠根據外部知識獲得高質量的回應。<lb/>因此，輸入上下文的長度大幅增加，導致預填充工作量增大，進而使得首次標記的時間（TTFT）變得更長。<lb/>雖然先前的研究有效地重用預計算的鍵值（KV）快取以減少長上下文輸入的TTFT，但當輸入上下文變得非常長時，回應質量是否得以保持仍然不清楚。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了一種結合的方法，(i) 在考慮KV快取串接的情況下微調模型，並且 (ii) 有選擇地重新計算KV快取的子集。<lb/>通過應用這兩種技術，我們展示了對長上下文輸入的準確性有所改善。<lb/>在RULER基準上的實驗顯示，對於124k標記的輸入，我們的方法使RULER分數比僅重新計算KV快取的基線提高了9.7分。<lb/>此外，與全注意力相比，TTFT減少了80%。
